what: Catack's take of the panel it drives onto, and the column timer that hands it back, mapped in both games for issue #837 (closed as BN5's own design): BN6 0x0800CC14 the setter and 0x0800CC36 the timer (0x708 into the column record 0x02034010 +6), Catack's take 0x0810D8E2-0x0810D904, the countdown 0x0800C746; BN5 0x0800B2D6, 0x0800B2F8 (0x02034020), 0x081093B8-0x081093DA. Names only, no code uses them (src/emu/bn6_panels.h, src/emu/bn5_liberation_rules.h; docs/rom/liberation.md, A panel taken and handed back).
